strengths.point: The project has a clear and well-structured README.md file that provides a good overview of the project's features and technologies used.
The ESLint configuration is well-defined and includes rules for React and JavaScript.
The project uses a modern and efficient build tool like Vite.
The codebase is relatively small and easy to navigate.
The project includes a basic implementation of a drawing canvas using React.

weaknesses.point: There are no tests written for the project, which makes it difficult to ensure the code's correctness and maintainability.
The codebase lacks documentation, which can make it harder for others to understand the project's functionality and implementation details.
The project's commit history is not well-organized, with 17 commits that could be grouped into smaller, more meaningful commits.
The project's code quality could be improved by following best practices such as using consistent naming conventions and formatting.
The project's dependencies are not listed in the README.md file, making it difficult to reproduce the project's environment.

roadmap: Write unit tests for the drawing canvas component to ensure its correctness and maintainability.
Improve code quality by following best practices such as using consistent naming conventions and formatting.
Organize the commit history by grouping related commits into smaller, more meaningful commits.
List the project's dependencies in the README.md file to make it easier to reproduce the project's environment.
Add more features to the project, such as real-time collaboration and AI-assisted features, to make it more comprehensive and useful.
Improve the project's documentation by adding comments and explanations to the code to make it easier for others to understand the project's functionality and implementation details.
